summary: Backend regression + new-feature coverage for taxman.manoj private client pricing + UPI manual verification. 21/21 tests in tests/test_pricing_upi.py PASSED (0 failures). Every requested contract verified: (A) GET /api/catalog and /api/catalog/{id} strip `price` and set price_visible=false; (B) /api/client/price returns assigned=true+amount for ITR Filing FY 2026-27 (=1699, AY 2027-28) and FY 2025-26 (=1499, AY 2026-27), and assigned=false+amount:null for Bank Reconciliation; (C) POST /api/client/requests returns HTTP 402 'Price not assigned' when no client_price exists, else creates request with server-authoritative price + populated AY and matching invoice.total; (D) After admin PUT /api/admin/prices/{id} changes amount, the pre-existing request.price and invoice.total remain immutable (snapshot verified via re-fetch); (E) /api/client/payments/initiate returns qr_base64 data-URL + vpa + upi_uri; /submit rejects non-12-digit UTR (400) and accepts 12-digit UTR setting status=submitted, status_label='Under Verification'; (F) POST /api/client/payments/{id}/screenshot (multipart PNG) succeeds, admin GET /api/admin/payments shows has_screenshot=true, GET /api/admin/payments/{id}/screenshot returns file_token, GET /api/gridfiles/{token} streams image/png; (G) POST /api/admin/payments/{id}/status {received} verifies linked request (payment_status=verified) and unlocks documents (client GET /client/documents/{id}/access -> file_token); flipping to under_verification re-locks (402); not_received also locks; payment.history array grows on each transition; (H) Legacy POST /api/admin/payments/{id}/verify {action:approve|reject} maps to received|not_received with legacy `status: verified|rejected` response; (I) Admin pricing CRUD: list returns prices[] + services[] (with suggested_price) + fy_list; POST create/update with uniqueness on client+service+fy+ay; PUT edits amount and toggles active writing history; GET returns full history (>=2 entries after edit); POST /api/admin/prices/bulk assigns to multiple clients (updated=1); (J) FY/AY scoping: paying TDS Return FY 2025-26 unlocks ONLY that request's docs; FY 2026-27 same-service request remains locked (402); (K) RBAC: plain client token -> 403 on /api/admin/clients/{id}/prices and /api/admin/payments/{id}/status; staff (accountant) without manage_staff -> 403 on POST /api/admin/staff; (L) Client isolation: freshly-registered client B gets 404 on client A's request, 403 on admin/payments/{id}/screenshot, and assigned=false on ITR Filing FY 2026-27 price lookup. Auth payload contract: /api/auth/login expects `identifier` (not `email`); /api/auth/verify-otp expects `code` (not `otp`) — tests updated accordingly. No new backend bugs found in this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: Server-authoritative pricing correctly enforced: create_request pulls price ONLY from client_prices; no fallback to catalog.price. 402 shape returned as required.
Snapshot immutability: request.price and invoice.total are copied at creation time from client_prices.amount and never re-derived; verified end-to-end.
Payment status transitions centralized in _apply_payment_status — single source of truth prevents drift between /status and legacy /verify endpoints, and always writes to history.
grid_token issuance requires manage_payments perm before signing — client B correctly blocked (403) at admin router dependency layer.
public_service() drops both `price` and `price_type` before serialization — no price leakage in catalog list or detail.
FY/AY scoping is inherent to the per-request payment_status field; unlock touches only the specific request. Confirmed by TDS Return dual-FY test.
